description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the estimate request. To enter or view additional information, click the  Long Description button.

requesttype.title: Request Type
requesttype.remarks: Identifies the type of, or reason for, estimates to be done under this request.

masterwonum.title: Target WO
masterwonum.remarks: The target work order for the estimate request type of Job, Project or Task. If you do not yet have a target work order you can enter a value later.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Site to which the request belongs ; defaults to the site specified in the user's  profile information.

requestnum.title: Estimate Request
requestnum.remarks: System generated unique identifier for the estimate record. You can overwrite this value until you save the estimate. After saving the record, this field becomes read only.

changeby.title: By
changeby.remarks: The login I.D. of the person who last changed the record.

changedate.title: Date
changedate.remarks: Date and time the record was last changed.

asbuiltversion.title: Accepted As-Built Version
asbuiltversion.remarks: Identifies the version number of the accepted version. Maximo enters the version  number in this field when you accept an Estimate Type of ASBUILT.

cnsttaskid.title: Default Craft WO/Task
cnsttaskid.remarks: The tasks that are on the default construction work order. If you did not select a default construction work order, the tasks on the target work order are shown. When you select a task, all the labor requirements from the estimate are copied to the task when the estimate is accepted.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: Identifies the organization to which the request belongs.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date and time the estimate status was last changed.

supporttaskid.title: Default Support WO/Task
supporttaskid.remarks: The tasks that are on the default support work order. If you did not select a default support work order, the tasks are shown on the target work order. When you select a task, the support activity labor requirements from the estimate are copied to the task when the estimate is accepted.

inprgversion.title: Accepted In Progress Version
inprgversion.remarks: Identifies the version number of the accepted version. Maximo enters the version number in this field when you accept an Estimate Type of INPRG

estimateaction.title: Estimate Action
estimateaction.remarks: Identifies action to be performed through the MEA for an external system

acceptedversion.title: Accepted Design Version
acceptedversion.remarks: Identifies the version number of the accepted version. Maximo enters the version  number in this field when you accept an estimate type of DESIGN.

cnstwonum.title: Default Craft WO/Task
cnstwonum.remarks: The child work order for construction. This work order must be a child of the target work order. If a compatible unit or station is not defined as support, then the associated labor is copied to the designated construction work order when you accept a version of the estimate.

supportwonum.title: Default Support WO/Task
supportwonum.remarks: The child work order for support activities. This work order must be a child of the target work order. Support activities can include creating the design, securing a permit, or any other pre-construction activity that is not included in the craft or construction labor estimate.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the estimate. Maximo changes the version's status when you  select the Perform Estimate, Peform Quote, and Peform Acceptance actions.
